white.$description: White — Bright text on dark CTAs, inset glows for definition

bright-gray.$description: Bright Gray — Primary body text, headings

medium-gray.$description: Medium Gray — Secondary text, navigation links

muted-gray.$description: Muted Gray — Tertiary text, subtle metadata

surface.$description: Surface — Card backgrounds, elevated UI panels

amethyst.$description: Amethyst — Primary CTA buttons—a sharp, functional accent against the dark theme

lavender.$description: Lavender — Links, badge text, and active states—the secondary, brighter interaction color

tag-background.$description: Tag Background — Background for tag/badge elements, used at 15% opacity

success-green.$description: Success Green — Success states or syntax highlighting within the app UI

warning-yellow.$description: Warning Yellow — Warning states or syntax highlighting within the app UI

error-red.$description: Error Red — Error states or syntax highlighting within the app UI

ui-sans-serif-system-ui.$description: Used for all text. The choice of a system font is deliberate, making the website feel like a native application—a functional tool for thought.
